queries.label: finerenone_ckd_dkd_t2d_randomised
queries.rationale: Primary registry query using molecule and brand/code aliases plus a widened condition axis, because the existing search record shows that a narrower condition phrase can miss a pivotal trial through registry indexing.

params.query.cond: chronic kidney disease OR diabetic kidney disease OR type 2 diabetes

queries.label: finerenone_free_text_kidney_diabetes_randomised
queries.rationale: Free-text backup for records where condition or intervention indexing is incomplete, while still naming finerenone, kidney/diabetes terms, and randomized allocation without seeding NCT identifiers.

params.query.term: (finerenone OR BAY 94-8862 OR Kerendia) AND (chronic kidney disease OR diabetic kidney disease OR type 2 diabetes OR T2DM)

queries.label: mra_kidney_diabetes_randomised
queries.rationale: Mechanism/intervention-class backup for registrations that describe finerenone as a non-steroidal mineralocorticoid receptor antagonist; screening must still verify finerenone and placebo before inclusion.

params.query.cond: kidney disease OR diabetic kidney disease OR diabetes mellitus type 2
params.query.intr: finerenone OR non-steroidal mineralocorticoid receptor antagonist OR mineralocorticoid receptor antagonist

known_limitation: ONE REGISTRY AND NO BIBLIOGRAPHIC DATABASE. These queries search ClinicalTrials.gov API v2 only; any recall statement is recall of this search, not recall of the literature, and trials absent from or differently indexed in this registry can be missed.
